fixture_class: 16x40 constant-color alpha steps, no resize, lossless native 4:4:4 AVIF or lossless PNG/WebP
justification: SDR permits three 8-bit code values for native blend rounding and two codec boundaries. HDR permits four 12-bit PQ code values for transfer LUT and encode/decode rounding, plus a separate 2% absolute ordinary-white check. Hidden RGB retention uses the same code-value limit with no visual-alpha masking. Every GIF alpha sample must match the declared 50% threshold exactly. These limits are scoped to constant-color selector controls, not photographic conversion qualification.
composition_reference: Test oracle uses straight-alpha linear-light source-over. sRGB background channels are decoded, converted via D65 matrices, and scaled so HDR sRGB white is 203 cd/m2. Native production candidate is FFmpeg/libplacebo multi-input composition; reference math is only in the proof.
